lessons.title: Household Chores, Rules and Obligations (must / have to)
lessons.description: Responsibilities at home, setting the table, vacuuming the floor

questions.rule:
• Household Chores:
- In the kitchen: Doing the dishes, loading/emptying the dishwasher, cooking meals, taking out the garbage.
- In the living room/bedroom: Vacuuming the floor, dusting the furniture, making the bed, tidying up the room.
- Laundry: Doing the laundry, hanging out the clothes, ironing.
- Outdoor: Mowing the lawn, washing the car, walking the dog.
• Expressing Obligation:
- Must / Have to: Zorunluluk bildiren kipler (I must tidy my room / She has to take out the trash).
- It's my duty / responsibility to... (Benim görevim/sorumluluğum).
- Be in charge of... (...den sorumlu olmak).
questions.examTip: LGS questions often ask: 'Who is in charge of kitchen chores?' or test tables showing family chore shares. Look at words like 'duty, responsibility, in charge of'!

questions.prompt: "My brother is in charge of taking out the garbage every evening." What does 'in charge of' mean?
questions.explanation: 'In charge of' bir işten veya görevden sorumlu olmak anlamına gelir.

questions.prompt: Which of the following chores is done OUTDOORS in the garden?
questions.explanation: Bahçedeki çimleri biçmek (mowing the lawn) bir dış mekan (outdoor) görevidir.

questions.prompt: Sharing household chores among family members makes home life easier and strengthens family cooperation.
questions.explanation: True! Ev işlerini aile bireyleri arasında paylaşmak işleri kolaylaştırır ve dayanışmayı artırır.

questions.prompt:
Mother: 'Dinner is ready! Can someone help me, please?'
Child: 'Sure mom, I can _____.' Which chore fits the kitchen table?
questions.explanation: Akşam yemeği hazır olduğunda masayı hazırlamaya 'set the table' denir.

questions.prompt: You must clean the carpets using a vacuum cleaner; this chore is called _____ the floor.
questions.explanation: Elektrikli süpürgeyle yerleri temizlemeye 'vacuuming the floor' denir.

questions.prompt: Match the chores with the household areas:

matchingPairs.right: Making the bed and tidying up toys
Watering the plants and mowing the lawn

questions.prompt: Which rule is a school library rule, NOT a home chore?
options: Keep quiet and return books on time
questions.explanation: Sessiz olmak ve kitapları zamanında teslim etmek kütüphane kuralıdır.

lessons.title: 🏆 Unit Trophy Exam: Chores Reading & Rule Matching Exam
lessons.description: LGS MEB household chore chart and responsibility analysis exam

questions.prompt: In the Miller family, Tom takes the dog for a walk, Lisa cleans the bathroom, and Dad washes the car. Who is responsible for pet care?
questions.explanation: Tom köpeği yürüyüşe çıkardığı için evcil hayvan bakımından Tom sorumludur.

questions.prompt: Which chore is related to clothes after they are washed and dried?
questions.explanation: Yıkanıp kuruyan kıyafetlerle ilgili iş ütü yapmaktır (ironing).

questions.prompt: It is necessary to follow classroom rules to maintain _____ and respect among students.
questions.explanation: Sınıf kurallarına uymak düzeni (order) ve saygıyı sağlar.

questions.prompt: "I hate doing the laundry, but I have to do it because all my clothes are dirty." What does 'have to' express?
questions.explanation: 'Have to' bir zorunluluğu ve gerekliliği (necessity/obligation) ifade eder.

questions.prompt: 'Dusting the furniture' means removing dirt and dust from tables, shelves, and chairs.
questions.explanation: True! 'Dusting the furniture' mobilyaların tozunu almak demektir.

questions.prompt: Which of the following chores does NOT belong to cleaning the kitchen?
questions.explanation: Yatağı toplamak (making the bed) yatak odası görevidir, mutfakla ilgisi yoktur.

questions.prompt: Match verbs with the correct chore nouns:
"We have a chore chart on the fridge so everybody knows their responsibilities." What is the purpose of this chart?
options: To divide household tasks fairly among family members
questions.explanation: Ev işleri tablosu görevleri aile fertleri arasında adilce paylaştırmak için hazırlanır.
